dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, is this your photo album? Can I look at it?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz ðɪs jʊr ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌælbəm? kən aɪ ˈlʊk ət ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. That's me and my dad. I remember flying kites with him in the park.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ðæts ˈmiː ənd maɪ ˈdæd. aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ˈflaɪɪŋ ˈkaɪts wɪð hɪm ɪn ðə ˈpɑːrk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How cute! How old were you?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈkjuːt! ˈhaʊ ˈoʊld wɜːr juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: About six. I have a lot of happy memories of that park.
dialogue.reading: əˈbaʊt ˈsɪks. aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈhæpi ˈmɛməriz əv ðæt ˈpɑːrk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And is that you on the swing?
dialogue.reading: ənd ɪz ðæt ˈjuː ɑːn ðə ˈswɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! I remember sitting on that swing for hours.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ˈsɪtɪŋ ɑːn ðæt ˈswɪŋ fər ˈaʊərz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I remember playing in the snow with my dad every winter.
dialogue.reading: aɪ rɪˈmɛmbər ˈpleɪɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈsnoʊ wɪð maɪ ˈdæd ˈɛvri ˈwɪntər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That sounds fun! Do you remember going to school for the first time?
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ˈfʌn! duː juː rɪˈmɛmbər ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈskuːl fər ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈtaɪm?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, I don't. But my mom says I cried all morning!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdoʊnt. bʌt maɪ ˈmɑːm ˈsɛz aɪ ˈkraɪd ˈɔːl ˈmɔːrnɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too! It's my first memory: crying at kindergarten.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈtuː! ɪts maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈmɛməri: ˈkraɪɪŋ ət ˈkɪndərɡɑːrtən.
